identity.description:
Reviewer briefing and reading plans (D7)

## Summary

This PR gives the reviewers the briefing and the reading procedure of D7. It closes #20 and #25. D6 already put the PR title, labels and body in the description block.

- The reviewer user message holds a `changed_files` block before the diff. A deleted file has its own line, because the head checkout has no file to read.
- Gather records the changed files that the change deletes.
- diff-bugs, history, tests and security each have a reading plan in numbered steps. Each plan starts with the changed files in full, then reads the callers and callees, then the tests that cover the changed behaviour. The history plan matches the blame lines of prior fixes against the diff. The security plan follows each outside input to its uses and reads the checks that guard each changed handler.
- conventions, docs-and-comments and description-drift get no read-in-full step. They work from the diff and read files only when they need context.
- The design (section 3.4) and TICKETS.md record the change.

## Eval

One repeat on the pinned cases (`e6ddf81`) against the 0.5.0 baseline. The gate passed.

| Metric | Baseline 0.5.0 | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Recall | 0.396 | 0.431 |
| Precision | 0.722 | 0.818 |
| Adjudicated precision | n/a | 0.939 |
| Raw recall | n/a | 0.616 |
| Cost per PR | $4.65 | $6.03 |

| Case | Raw recall | Recall | Precision | Posted | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| martian-calcom-8330 | 0.714 | 0.571 | 0.667 | 6 | $11.23 |
| martian-discourse-graphite-1 | 1.000 | 0.625 | 0.833 | 6 | $14.29 |
| martian-sentry-93824 | 0.889 | 0.778 | 1.000 | 7 | $7.90 |
| martian-sentry-greptile-1 | 0.889 | 0.667 | 0.750 | 8 | $11.65 |
| reviewbench-axios-10836 | 1.000 | 0.500 | 1.000 | 1 | $1.40 |
| reviewbench-claire-de-binare-1550 | 0.000 | 0.000 | - | 0 | $3.44 |
| reviewbench-disaster-ninja-fe-1166 | 1.000 | 0.667 | 0.667 | 3 | $3.70 |
| reviewbench-ensnode-1938 | 0.000 | 0.000 | - | 0 | $0.74 |
| reviewbench-flatten-js-244 | 0.333 | 0.167 | 1.000 | 1 | $2.99 |
| reviewbench-statswales-frontend-626 | 0.333 | 0.333 | 1.000 | 1 | $2.91 |

Cost per PR rose by 30%. One repeat gives no spread, so the gains in recall and precision can be noise. The baseline has no raw recall to compare with.

This eval ran before the last commit. In that run, every reviewer got the read-in-full instruction. conventions, docs-and-comments and description-drift cost $7.37 over ten cases against $3.28 before D7. The last commit removes the instruction from those three, which should save about $0.40 per PR. That commit has no eval run of its own yet.

## Test plan

- [x] `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass.
- [x] The eval runs at one repeat on the pinned cases and the gate passes.
